lines.en: label christmastwo8:
scene christmaskaraoke1
A scene not at all dissimilar from many I’ve witnessed in the past- accompanied by scent of various baked goods and...alcohol?
lines.zh: 这一幕和我过去见过的许多场景没什么两样——伴随着各种烘焙点心的香味，还有……酒味？

lines.en: Oh well. I guess if my students are going to start recreationally drinking, it’s better if I’m around them or-
lines.zh: 算了。既然我的学生们迟早要开始“娱乐性饮酒”，那有我在旁边看着总比——

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes18
scene christmaskaraoke1
Anyway, it looks like Yasu is doing fine, so I will now label my mission from Touka as complete and hope she does not misplace my present and make me look worse than I already am.
lines.zh: 总之，Yasu 看起来状态不错，那么 Touka 交给我的任务就算完成了，只希望她别把我的礼物弄丢，让我显得比现在更难看。

lines.en: Which is pretty bad since I’ve already had sex with a decent portion of this room.
lines.zh: 而我已经很难看了，因为这屋子里有相当一部分人都和我上过床。

lines.en: : I am impressed by your ability to accurately replicate this song, Strawberry Princess.
lines.zh: : 你能把这首歌还原得这么准确，真让我佩服，草莓公主。

lines.en: : Every time I have attempted to sing, it has ended in tragedy.
lines.zh: : 我每次试着唱歌，最后都以悲剧收场。

lines.en: : I believe the Emerald Guardian has said something about multiple notes being required, while I only know one of them.
lines.zh: : 我记得翡翠守护者说过，好像需要多个音符才行，而我只会其中一个。

lines.en: Ami doesn’t respond to Tsuneyo on account of her undying desire to always be the center of someone’s attention and just keeps singing away at some song I’m sure I’ve heard playing in her room before.
lines.zh: Ami 没有理会 Tsuneyo，因为她那“永远要成为某人视线中心”的执念不死，只是一个劲地唱着某首我确信以前在她房间里听到过的歌。

lines.en: The song doesn’t really have anything to do with Christmas, but it’s not like I’m complaining about that.
lines.zh: 这首歌和圣诞节其实没什么关系，不过我也没打算抱怨这个。

lines.en: Frankly, Christmas music joins the ranks of things like the obligation to buy presents or...bright lights as yet one more characteristic that makes this time of year hard to deal with.
lines.zh: 说实话，圣诞音乐和“必须买礼物”的义务啦、或者……刺眼的彩灯啦归为一类，都是让这个时节变得难熬的特征之一。

lines.en: Speaking of things that are hard to deal with, maybe I {i}should{/i} try and see if Yasu is at least...conscious.
lines.zh: 说到难熬，也许我{i}该{/i}去确认一下 Yasu 至少还……清醒着。

lines.en: She’s been standing as still as a statue for as long as I’ve been looking at her- which is a vast departure from her seemingly inherent desire to always wander around when she’s not busy “praying.”
lines.zh: 自我看着她起，她就一直像座雕像一样一动不动地站着——这和她不忙着“祈祷”时似乎天生就爱到处乱逛的性子相去甚远。

lines.en: Oh. Maybe that’s it.
lines.zh: 哦。也许就是这个原因。

lines.en: Maybe this is just another example of some ridiculous religious practice that I neither want to nor have the mental capacity to understand.
lines.zh: 也许这又是什么我既不想、也没脑力去理解的荒唐宗教仪式。

lines.en: Yeah. That’s it.
lines.zh: 嗯。就是这样。

lines.en: My mission really is complete after all.
lines.zh: 我的任务确实算是完成了。

lines.en: Okay, I’m going to go talk to someone else before staring at her any longer begins to rot my brain.
lines.zh: 好吧，我得去找别人聊聊了，别再盯着她看，再看下去脑子都要烂掉了。

lines.en: scene black
scene christmaskaraoke2
: Sensei! What a pleasant surprise! I totally haven’t spent the entire day waiting for you to get here or anything!
lines.zh: : 老师！真是惊喜！我绝对没有一整天都在等你过来什么的！

lines.en: : The entire day? You were literally at my house this morning.
lines.zh: : 一整天？你今天早上明明还在我家。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke3
: Yeah, about that! Why did you lock your door?! I wanted to come say good morning!
lines.zh: : 啊，说到这个！你为什么锁门？！我还想进来跟你说早安呢！

lines.en: : To prevent you from sneaking into my bedroom in the middle of the night, obviously.
lines.zh: : 当然是为了防止你半夜偷偷溜进我的卧室。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke4
: Ohhhh, I see. You were just worried you wouldn’t get any sleep on account of-
lines.zh: : 哦————我懂了。你是担心自己睡不着，因为——

lines.en: : Ahem.
lines.zh: : Ahem.

lines.en: I clear my throat and make an obvious gesture toward Karin, who is becoming increasingly uncomfortable with the direction this conversation is beginning to head in.
lines.zh: 我清了清嗓子，明显地朝 Karin 使了个眼色——她对这段对话的走向越来越不自在了。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke5
: On account of all of the Christmas movies we were supposed to watch together, obviously!
lines.zh: : 因为我们要一起看好多圣诞电影，当然了！

lines.en: : Ah! You guys were going to watch Christmas movies?! I used to watch those with Kirin all the time before she...
lines.zh: : 啊！你们要看圣诞电影？！我以前经常和 Kirin 一起看来着，在她……

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke6
: Decided she didn’t like me anymore...
lines.zh: : 决定不再喜欢我之前……

lines.en: : Uhh...
: You can...watch them {i}with{/i} us next year?
lines.zh: : 你……明年可以{i}和我们{/i}一起看？

lines.en: : Ayane, why are you making plans for next Christmas in the middle of the current one?
lines.zh: : Ayane，你为什么在今年的圣诞节进行到一半的时候就开始计划明年的圣诞节了？

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke7
: I panicked! You saw how sad she looked!
lines.zh: : 我慌了嘛！你看到她有多伤心了！

lines.en: : Besides, you never know when time might get all weird and like...start over or something!
lines.zh: : 再说，谁知道时间会不会突然变得很奇怪，比如……重新开始什么的！

lines.en: : I...would love watching movies with you guys, but...I don’t know if I’d...want to watch them in...S...S...S-
lines.zh: : 我……我很乐意和你们一起看电影，但是……我不知道我……想不想在……老……老……

lines.en: : Sensei’s room. Ayane, what did you just say?
lines.zh: : 老师的房间里。Ayane，你刚刚说了什么？

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke8
: Hm? The time thing?
lines.zh: : 嗯？时间那个？

lines.en: : Yeah. Say it again.
lines.zh: : 对。再说一遍。

lines.en: : That...we never know when time might start over?
lines.zh: : 就是……我们永远不知道时间什么时候会重新开始？

lines.en: : I wasn’t being serious, but...you look really interested all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我那只是随口一说，不过……你突然看起来很感兴趣。

lines.en: : So it’s just a random thought that popped into your head? There’s no...deeper meaning or anything?
lines.zh: : 所以那只是你脑子里冒出来的一个随机念头？没有什么……更深层的含义之类的？

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke9
: Are...you interested in time travel, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师……你对时间旅行感兴趣吗？

lines.en: : If...time travel is even what we’re talking about, I mean. I’m having an admittedly hard time following right now.
lines.zh: : 如果……我们聊的确实是时间旅行的话。说实话我现在有点跟不上。

lines.en: : Not particularly. Ayane just said something that sounded a little strange to me, is all.
lines.zh: : 也不是特别感兴趣。只是 Ayane 刚才说的那句话我听着有点怪，就这样。

lines.en: Especially considering the last time there actually {i}was{/i} a reset, Ayane showed up halfway through only to subsequently disappear a few minutes later.
lines.zh: 尤其是考虑到上一次真的{i}发生{/i}重置的时候，Ayane 中途出现了几分钟，随后又消失了。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke10
: I say strange things all of the time. It’s like, a cornerstone of my bubbly, rambunctious personality. How come this one is the one you single out as being “too weird?”
lines.zh: : 我平时就经常说些奇怪的话。这可是我活泼、闹腾的性格的基石之一。为什么偏偏这句被你挑出来当成“太奇怪”了？

lines.en: : All things considered, I think it’s one of the more...tame things I’ve said.
lines.zh: : 综合来看，我觉得这算是我说过的比较……温和的话了。

lines.en: : What if I told you that you’re not far from the truth, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，如果我告诉你，你其实离真相不远呢？

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke11
: Are you asking me what I’d do if we only had a brief amount of time left before the world started over? Because the answer is simple, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 你是在问，如果世界重新开始之前我们只剩一小段时间，我会怎么做吗？因为答案很简单，老师！

lines.en: : I’d make you mine and stop worrying about other people getting in the way! And spend every single second with you until my random time prediction came true!
lines.zh: : 我会让你成为我的人，再也不用担心别人碍事！然后把每一秒都和你一起度过，直到我那个随口说的时间预言成真！

lines.en: : Then, I’d do it all over again from the beginning, knowing full-well that the world is on a repeating cycle!
lines.zh: : 然后，我会明知道世界正处于循环之中，还是从最初再来一遍！

lines.en: : Like I said, it’s simple! What else would you expect me to do in a world where the two of us are infinite?
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，很简单！在一个我们俩都是无限的世界里，你还指望我做什么别的？

lines.en: : Maybe freak out a little more about the idea of circular time but, you know, I realize now that this was just wishful thinking on my part.
lines.zh: : 也许该对“循环时间”这个想法反应更大一点吧，不过嘛，我现在明白了，这只是我的一厢情愿。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke12
: I’m not sure where this sudden fascination with the weird things I say came from, but I’m just going to chalk it up to you falling more in love with me if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你突然对我说的怪话这么上心是从哪来的，不过我打算把它归结为“你更爱我了”，可以吧。

lines.en: : And I’m...also here still...
lines.zh: : 而且我……还在这儿呢……

lines.en: : Would you like to share your thoughts on the concept of time, Karin? Quietly, though, so Maya doesn’t overhear anything and suddenly get invested.
lines.zh: : 你想说说你对时间这个概念的看法吗，Karin？不过小声点，别让 Maya 听见然后突然来了兴趣。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke13
: I’ve...never really thought about it...
lines.zh: : 我……从来没有认真想过……

lines.en: : And I definitely didn’t expect to be talking about it at a Christmas party, but...
lines.zh: : 而且我绝对没想到会在圣诞派对上聊这个，不过……

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke14
: I think...time is...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……时间是……

lines.en: : Neat?...
lines.zh: : 挺不错？……

lines.en: : Well said, Karin! I think my infinite love story was a little more interesting, though. But I’m sure that if you keep working hard, you’ll find someone you love as much as I love Sensei one day.
lines.zh: : 说得好，Karin！不过我觉得我那个无限爱情故事更有趣一点。但我相信只要你继续努力，总有一天也会找到像我爱老师那样深爱的人。

lines.en: : Then, you can have your own infinite love story!
lines.zh: : 那样你也能拥有属于自己的无限爱情故事了！

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke15
: HAHAHAHA! L-L-L-LOVE! FUNNY JOKE, AYANE!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈！爱——爱——爱情！真好笑的玩笑，Ayane！

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke16
: Why...did I just yell that?
lines.zh: : 我……刚才为什么喊那么大声？

lines.en: : Umm...anyway, what do you plan on doing for the rest of the night, Sensei? Just going to walk around and maaaaybe think of your favorite rich girl all night or something?
lines.zh: : 嗯……话说回来，老师你今晚剩下的时间打算做什么？就这么到处走走，或————许整晚想着你最喜欢的那个有钱人家的女孩？

lines.en: : I already talked to Touka today. I don’t have to think about her anymore.
lines.zh: : 我今天已经和 Touka 说过话了。我不用再想她了。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke17
: Hey! That’s mean! I didn’t realize this was a category I actually had to compete in! I love you way more than Touka ever will!
lines.zh: : 喂！太过分了！我都不知道原来这个项目也是要比赛的！我可比 Touka 爱你多了！

lines.en: : I’ve even been holding onto this crisp, refreshing bottle of Coca-Cola for you ever since I got here!
lines.zh: : 我从到这儿起就一直替你攥着这瓶清爽可口的可口可乐！
: ……为什么？

lines.en: : To prove my love!
lines.zh: : 为了证明我的爱！

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke18
: Nothing says love like sharing a Coke.
lines.zh: : 没有什么比分享一瓶可乐更能表达爱意了。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke19
: Okay. Well, I’m going to go see how a significantly shorter group of girls is doing and...I guess I’ll see you two around.
lines.zh: : 好。那我要去看看另一群个子明显矮一些的女孩怎么样了，然后……我想回头再见吧。

lines.en: : Okay! We’re not going anywhere, so feel free to drop by whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 好的！我们哪儿也不去，你随时欢迎过来。

lines.en: : Also, if that whole time thing really does start happening and you want to embark on our epic journey of romance and {i}handholding{/i}, please don’t hesitate to contact me!
lines.zh: : 另外，如果那个“时间的事”真的开始发生，而你想踏上我们那场浪漫又{i}牵手{/i}的史诗之旅，请务必联系我！

lines.en: : Ayane Amamiya is open 24/7 when it comes to her beloved teacher slash future husband.
lines.zh: : Ayane Amamiya 面对她挚爱的老师兼未来丈夫，24 小时全年无休。

lines.en: : And...uhh...I will...also be here...
lines.zh: : 而且……呃……我也会……在这儿……

lines.en: scene black
I step away from Ayane and Karin and help myself to a crisp, refreshing Coca-Cola on the way across the room.
lines.zh: 我离开 Ayane 和 Karin，穿过房间时顺手给自己拿了一瓶清爽可口的可口可乐。

lines.en: The group of girls crowding around the karaoke machine has since increased in size with Uta and Touka (Who managed to slip inside without me noticing) forming a small semi-circle around my [niece].
lines.zh: 围在卡拉 OK 机旁的女孩又多了几个，Uta 和 Touka（她居然在我没注意的时候溜进来了）在我的 [niece] 周围围成了一个小半圆。

lines.en: It will only be a matter of time until Ami is forced to stop singing and surrender the microphone to one of the others, though.
lines.zh: 不过 Ami 被迫停下歌声、把麦克风让给别人，也只是时间问题。

lines.en: And even though the amount of attention she’s receiving right now should sustain her for the next several hours or so, I’m sure she’ll find another way to feed off of all of our energy soon enough.
lines.zh: 尽管她现在得到的关注应该够她撑上好几个小时，但我敢肯定她很快就会找到别的办法来吸食我们的能量。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke20
: Merry Christmas, Sensei! Thank you for another year of making sure I don’t have to learn anythin’ in class!
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐，老师！谢谢你又一年的“让我上课什么都没学到”！

lines.en: : {i}Another{/i} year?
lines.zh: : {i}又{/i}一年？

lines.en: : Hm? S’at a weird thing to say?
lines.zh: : 嗯？这话有那么奇怪吗？

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke21
: I think he...means since...he’s only been our teacher for one...
lines.zh: : 我觉得他的意思是……毕竟……他当我们的老师才一……

lines.en: : Really? I guess time really does fly when ‘yer havin’ fun, then.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那看来快乐的时候时间确实过得飞快啊。

lines.en: : Speaking of fun, do you know what {i}I{/i} think would be fun, Miku? Not looking at Touka all night.
lines.zh: : 说到快乐，你知道{i}我{/i}觉得什么才快乐吗，Miku？今晚一整晚都别看 Touka。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke22
: But you {i}love{/i} lookin’ at girls! ‘Specially ones with massive dohoonkabhankoloos.
lines.zh: : 可是你{i}最爱{/i}看女生了！特别是那种有着巨无霸的家伙。

lines.en: : I like staring at all girls equally, thank you very much. I just mean that {i}you{/i} in particular shouldn’t look at her.
lines.zh: : 我对所有女生都一视同仁地看，谢谢。我只是说{i}你{/i}特别不应该看她。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke23
: Uh...you mind if I ask why? Or is that gonna somehow ruin all of the fun you think I’ll have ignorin’ a classmate?
lines.zh: : 呃……介意我问一下为什么吗？还是说问了就会破坏你以为我“无视同学”能得到的全部乐趣？

lines.en: : She’s just carrying a thing you’re not allowed to see. It wouldn’t have been an issue if I had just followed the rules- but rules are for losers.
lines.zh: : 她只是拿着一个你不能看的东西。如果我守规矩本来也不会有这问题——但规矩是给失败者定的。

lines.en: : I still don’t get it, but I’ll trust ya. Whaddya want me to do if she tries to talk to me, though?
lines.zh: : 我还是没懂，不过我信你。可要是她想跟我说话，你让我怎么办？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Talk about being poor or something. That might scare her away.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。聊聊贫穷什么的。说不定能吓跑她。

lines.en: : But...Touka has been...getting a lot better about...um...accepting us...non-rich people...
lines.zh: : 但是……Touka 已经……在……嗯……接纳我们这些非富人了……进步很大了……

lines.en: : You’re all getting better at all sorts of things, but you’ll still always have your weaknesses.
lines.zh: : 你们在各方面都在进步，但你们永远都会有自己的弱点。

lines.en: : Uh-oh. Sensei’s goin’ into life lesson mode. Put back on your earmuffs, Sana.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，老师要进入“人生课堂模式”了。Sana，把耳罩戴回去。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke24
: I’m not going into {i}any{/i} mode. I just think it’s beneficial to never expect anyone to fully recover from the things that bring them down.
lines.zh: : 我才没有进入{i}什么{/i}模式。我只是觉得，永远别指望有人能从打倒他们的东西里彻底恢复，这是有益的。

lines.en: : It’s why I’d never send Sana out to buy lunch for me and why I’d never put you in a loud-
lines.zh: : 这就是为什么我绝不会派 Sana 出去替我买午饭，也绝不会把你放到一个吵——

lines.en: : Wait, how are you doing right now, Miku?
lines.zh: : 等等，你现在怎么样，Miku？

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke25
: You’re sure askin’ me a lot of questions tonight, Sensei. You sure you don’t wanna shoot some of ‘em Sana’s way as well?
lines.zh: : 老师你今晚问题可真多啊。你确定不分几个给 Sana 吗？

lines.en: : I just mean with all of the noise. It’s pretty loud in here and you seem fine.
lines.zh: : 我只是说噪音的事。这里挺吵的，而你看起来没事。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke26
: O-Oh! You mean with that...
lines.zh: : 哦——哦！你是说那件事……

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m doin’ okay. Makoto and I got here a little after everybody else, so I haven’t been puttin’ up with it for long.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我还好。Makoto 和我比大家晚到一会儿，所以我还没被折磨多久。

lines.en: : Don’t know what that means for later, but...I’m all good right now. Peachy as a...peach.
lines.zh: : 不知道待会儿会怎样，不过……我现在完全没问题。好得像个……桃子。

lines.en: : Where {i}is{/i} Makoto, actually? It’s rare to see you two separated at parties and I haven’t seen her yet.
lines.zh: : 话说 Makoto {i}在哪儿{/i}？派对上很少看到你们俩分开，我还没见到她。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke27
: I...umm...think she went into the bedroom with...Nodoka and...Miss Imai.
lines.zh: : 我……嗯……觉得她跟 Nodoka 还有 Imai 老师进卧室了。

lines.en: : I was really worried about the context of that sentence until you said Imani was there, too.
lines.zh: : 在你提到 Imani 也在之前，我真挺担心这句话的语境的。

lines.en: Now, I’m just even more excited.
lines.zh: 现在我只剩兴奋了。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: I don’t know how Imani feels about sexual contact with students, but I’m hoping her opinion isn’t {i}too{/i} far off from mine or it might be a little too hard for the two of us to really understand one another.
lines.zh: 我不知道 Imani 对和学生发生性接触是什么态度，但我希望她的看法别和我差{i}太{/i}远，否则我们俩可能很难真正理解彼此。

lines.en: : Wait, why is Imani here? Who invited her?
lines.zh: : 等等，Imani 为什么会在这里？谁请她来的？

lines.en: : Do you not want her to be here or somethin’, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你是不希望她在这儿吗，老师？

lines.en: : Think she might get in the way of you spendin’ some alone time with my BFF or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 觉得她可能妨碍你和我的好闺蜜独处？

lines.en: : I’m just surprised she came on such short notice. Or...how she even knew about it in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我只是惊讶她接到通知这么短就来了。或者……她一开始是怎么知道的。

lines.en: : You...know you can just...ask her...right?
lines.zh: : 你……知道你可以直接……去问她……对吧？

lines.en: : I’m really not liking your attitude tonight, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我今晚真的很不喜欢你的态度，Sana。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke28
: Wh-What attitude?! I haven’t done anything!
lines.zh: : 什——什么态度？！我什么都没做！

lines.en: : Are you raising your voice at me right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在对我大喊大叫吗？

lines.en: : No! Yes! I don’t know!
lines.zh: : 没有！有！我不知道！

lines.en: : Sana, I’m really going to need you to calm down.
lines.zh: : Sana，我真的需要你冷静下来。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke29
: Mm!
lines.zh: : Mm!

lines.en: : Sensei! The heck do ya think you’re doin’?! You made Sana cry and you’ve only been here for like ten minutes!
lines.zh: : 老师！你到底在搞什么鬼？！你才来了十分钟就把 Sana 弄哭了！

lines.en: : Sana, why are you crying? I thought it was obvious I was just kidding.
lines.zh: : Sana，你为什么哭？我以为我明显是在开玩笑。

lines.en: : I...just am!
lines.zh: : 我……就是想哭！

lines.en: : It’s no big deal!
lines.zh: : 没什么大不了的！

lines.en: : Do you need me to-
lines.zh: : 需要我——

lines.en: : No thank you!
lines.zh: : 不用了谢谢！

lines.en: : But I didn’t even-
lines.zh: : 可我连——

lines.en: : Sensei, let me field this one. You go hang out with Makoto and maybe plant a big wet one on those luscious lips of hers right in front of the new teacher.
lines.zh: : 老师，这个交给我。你去跟 Makoto 待着，最好当着新老师的面在她那诱人的嘴唇上狠狠亲一口。

lines.en: : Really just assert your dominance. Alpha style.
lines.zh: : 好好宣示一下主权。阿尔法风格。

lines.en: : Great idea, Miku. I’m sure randomly kissing someone like that wouldn’t have any repercussions whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 好主意，Miku。我敢肯定随随便便这么亲一个人不会有任何后果。

lines.en: scene christmaskaraoke30
: What do drums have to do with this?! Get over there and mingle, coach! Do what ya came here to do! Talk to girls and conquer hearts!
lines.zh: : 这跟鼓有什么关系？！过去那儿社交啊，教练！干你来这儿该干的事！跟女生说话，征服芳心！

lines.en: scene black
: Fine. But I’m only doing this because it’ll make it look like you made Sana cry instead of me.
lines.zh: : 行。不过我做这个只是因为这样看起来像是你把 Sana 弄哭的，而不是我。

lines.en: : Ain’t nobody gonna think that, Sen-
lines.zh: : 没人会这么想的，老——

lines.en: : Miku! Why is Sana crying?! What did you do?!
lines.zh: : Miku！Sana 为什么在哭？！你干了什么？！

lines.en: : I...ahh! Crap!
lines.zh: : 我……啊！糟了！

lines.en: : Sensei! Come back!
lines.zh: : 老师！回来！

lines.en: Farewell, Miku.
lines.zh: 别了，Miku。

lines.en: Hello, everyone else.
lines.zh: 你们好啊，其他各位。
